description.en: A traditional cookie recipe for the Purim holiday, yielding about 20 cookies. Chocolate chips are also a great filling option.
description.he: מתכון מסורתי לעוגיות לחג הפורים, מניב כ-20 עוגיות. שוקולד צ'יפס הם גם אופציה נהדרת למילוי.

en: Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface.
Fill circles with lekvar or Apricot butter.
Pinch on 3 sides into Δ shape.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375°F about 20 minutes.
he: רדדו את הבצק על משטח מקומח קלות.
מלאו את העיגולים בריבת שזיפים (לקוואר) או ריבת משמש.
אפו על תבנית עוגיות משומנת בחום של 375°F (כ-190°C) למשך כ-20 דקות.

ocrRawText:
Haman taschen
1/2
2 cups

1 1/3 cups flour
1 1/2 tsp. baking powder
1/4 cup margarine
1/4 cup sugar
Blend: 1 tsp. vanilla
1/2
1 tsp. almond flavoring
3/16
1/8 tsp. salt.
1/2
1 Egg

Cream margarine + sugar. Add egg, flavorings.
Add dry ingredients. Roll out dough on a lightly
floured surface. Cut circle with a glass (2 1/2" - 3")
Fill circles with lekvar or Apricot butter. Pinch
on 3 sides into Δ shape. Bake on greased
cookie sheet at 375°F about 20 minutes.
yield - 20.

Enjoy! Happy Purim!

* chocolate chips are great for filling too!
rankingReason: Result A has more accurate ingredient measurements (1 1/3 cups flour and 1 1/2 tsp baking powder vs Result B's 1 1/6 cups and 2/3 tsp), which align better with the ocrRawText shown in both results. Result A's instructions are clearer and better organized (8 distinct steps vs 4 combined steps in B). Result B has a problematic instruction step 3 that reads awkwardly ('Cut circles with a glass (3") — 3" fill circles...') and contains a transcription error ('lever' instead of 'lekvar'). Result A also has fewer tags but they're all appropriate, while Result B adds 'pareve' which may not be accurate given the margarine ingredient. Both have good bilingual content, but A's accuracy in measurements and clarity in instructions make it the better extraction.
